info.title: CF Meet public API — developer-platform
info.description: Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id.

get.summary: List the caller's organizations (a machine credential sees only its own)
get.description: List the caller's organizations (a machine credential sees only its own). Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

post.summary: Create an organization; the creator becomes its OWNER
post.description: Create an organization; the creator becomes its OWNER. Platform Access creates the canonical EXTERNAL tenant.

get.summary: Read an organization (including its Platform Access classification)
get.description: Read an organization (including its Platform Access classification). Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

patch.description: Update the organization profile (optimistic concurrency). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `organizations.manage`.

post.summary: Close the organization (terminal; machine access is withdrawn in Platform Access first)
post.description: Close the organization (terminal; machine access is withdrawn in Platform Access first). Roles: OWNER.

get.description: List human workspace members. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

patch.description: Change a member's role (the last OWNER can never be demoted). Roles: OWNER.

delete.description: Remove a member (OWNER) or leave (self); never the last OWNER. Roles: OWNER, or the member themself.

post.description: Transfer ownership: the target member becomes OWNER and the caller becomes ADMIN, atomically. Roles: OWNER.

post.description: Accept an invitation with its one-time token; the session's verified email must equal the invited address.

post.description: Suspend the project (its Platform Access application is suspended). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

post.description: Create a SANDBOX or TEST environment (Platform Access creates the canonical environment). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

get.description: Current plan assignment(s) and billing-account reference. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, BILLING.

get.description: Active commercial plan versions (entitlement profiles; no prices).

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

userSession.description: The signed-in developer's CF Meet session (Developer Console). Never a machine credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.

platform-developer.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain an identifier, credential, token or database text.

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

platform-developer.control.v1.ActivityLi.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.BillingAcc.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

platform-developer.control.v1.Commercial.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.
A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

kind.description: PRODUCTION environments are activated by the production-access workflow (Section 55).

platform-developer.control.v1.Entitlemen.description: Effective platform entitlements: organization plan, stricter project plan and environment caps; the most restrictive value wins and the limiting level is named.

id.description: The canonical Platform Access environment id.

authorityStatus.description: Status reported by Platform Access (GET of one environment).

platform-developer.control.v1.Environmen.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

userId.description: Opaque CF Meet account id (human developer); not a Platform Access principal.

classification.description: Platform Access tenant classification (operator-controlled; GET of one organization only).

platform-developer.control.v1.Organizati.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.PlanAssign.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

id.description: The project id IS the canonical Platform Access application id.

platform-developer.control.v1.ProjectLis.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

scopes.description: Platform Access application scope grants (Platform Access is the authority).
